diff --git a/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2CumulativeReview.kt b/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2CumulativeReview.kt
index 48f75005..c4ab303f 100644
--- a/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2CumulativeReview.kt
+++ b/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2CumulativeReview.kt
@@ -503,7 +503,7 @@ internal fun createCumulativeReviewAssignment(pack: V2CurriculumPack, learner: V
             reviewUnitDigest(pack, unit.number), teachingDigest(pack, o))
     }
     val a = CumulativeReviewAssignment(id, targetUnit, policy.id,
-        policy.digest, closedResponseRuleDigest(), boundary, slots, "",
+        policy.digest, presentedReviewResponseRuleDigest(), boundary, slots, "",
         schema = assignmentSchema)
     return a.copy(digest = reviewAssignmentDigest(a))
 }
@@ -553,7 +553,7 @@ internal fun reviewAssignmentCurrent(pack: V2CurriculumPack, a: CumulativeReview
     if (!cumulativeReviewDeclarationValid(pack, a.targetUnit) || pack.schemaVersion != 1 ||
         !reviewAssignmentSchemaSupported(a) || a.id.isBlank() || a.boundary < 0 ||
         a.policyId != policy.id || a.policyDigest != policy.digest ||
-        a.responseRuleDigest != closedResponseRuleDigest() ||
+        !reviewResponseRuleSupported(a.responseRuleDigest) ||
         a.slots.size != policy.pool.size || a.digest != reviewAssignmentDigest(a)) return false
     return a.slots.zip(policy.pool).all { (s, spec) ->
         val unit = pack.unit(s.ownerUnit) ?: return@all false

diff --git a/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2Validator.kt b/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2Validator.kt
index 46968b82..885fe7ec 100644
--- a/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2Validator.kt
+++ b/app/src/main/java/dev/russiancompanion/v2/curriculum/V2Validator.kt
@@ -4486,11 +4486,12 @@ internal object V2Validator {
         val answerAt = original.indexOf(answer)
         val distractorAt = original.indexOf(distractor)
         if (answerAt < 0 || distractorAt < 0) return false
-        val between = if (answerAt < distractorAt) {
-            original.substring(answerAt + answer.length, distractorAt)
-        } else {
-            original.substring(distractorAt + distractor.length, answerAt)
-        }
+        // Overlapping occurrences (for example perfective inside imperfective) are not
+        // two distinct glosses joined by an alternative marker.
+        val from = if (answerAt < distractorAt) answerAt + answer.length else distractorAt + distractor.length
+        val until = maxOf(answerAt, distractorAt)
+        if (from > until) return false
+        val between = original.substring(from, until)
         return between.length <= 24 && Regex("(?i)\\bor\\b").containsMatchIn(between)
     }
